inlines.v: PERTU'SION, noun s as z. [Latin pertusus, pertundo.] 1. The act of punching, piercing or thrusting through with a pointed instrument. The manner of opening a vein in Hippocrates's time, was by stabbing or pertusion 2. A little hole made by punching; a perforation.
